selection_reason: Screen whether the statutory record can support a different-company boundary case for control rights versus operating integration. The allowed sources cover only the 2005 control transaction, 2006 sales-agency operating interface, and the first full FY2006 target-company baseline; no FY2007 or later operating body is selected.

source_research_rationales.selection_reason: Locate the statutory acquisition terms, legal control rights and stated transaction perimeter before treating the buyer as an operating owner.
Read the target board's contemporaneous account of the acquisition and any stated risks or counterarguments.
Establish the disclosed sales-agency operating interface rather than infer integration from equity ownership.
Determine whether the disclosed sales-agency interface was executed and what it did or did not cover.

Establish the first statutory target-company operating, product-economics and cash baseline available after control/interface implementation, including restatement, audit and entity-boundary limitations that must govern any later outcome contract.
